name: Mangalore
desc: Families and professionals in Mangalore, Karnataka trust Insurance Support for transparent, independent insurance advisory. From policy selection to complex claim recoveries, our IRDAI-certified experts provide dedicated doorstep service.
it_focus: Portable health and term insurance for engineers at MRPL, Baikampady industrial estate, and IT companies near KSRTC Bejai.
senior_focus: Doorstep health insurance and LIC policy servicing for senior Catholic and community families in Kankanady, Falnir, and Kadri.
branch_dets: Coordination with LIC branch at Hampankatta and health insurer offices in Kankanady.

local_faqs.question: Which Mangalore hospitals are in the cashless network?
local_faqs.answer: Father Muller Hospital, KMC Hospital Attavar, A J Hospital, and Indiana Hospital are all in our cashless network.

local_faqs.question: Can you help NRIs in Gulf countries manage family insurance in Mangalore?
local_faqs.answer: Yes, we manage NRI parent health insurance, LIC policy servicing, and documentation for families in Gulf countries with origin in Mangalore.
